failed_reason: Insufficient real curated photos. The business's own public Instagram account (@alpha_mobile_detail, confirmed real via ig_photos.py + Facebook cross-check) returned 11 downloadable public photos, but ALL 11 are personal/unrelated content (a child on a porch, a black-and-white photo of a man playing trumpet, thrift-store shopping items, a couple selfie, a screenshot of iPhone Notification Center text messages, three people in Halloween pumpkin-head costumes on a residential street, a couple dressed up for an event, a screenshot of a Donald Trump video/Reels thumbnail, a jar of Flintstones gummies, and a deck of Uno cards on a table). ZERO photos show a vehicle being detailed, a before/after result, a clean car interior, or the work van/equipment. Facebook (facebook.com/alphamobiledetail/, 319 likes, confirmed real via direct fetch with facebookexternalhit user agent) only exposes its profile picture (the business logo graphic) through og:image; the actual photo timeline/reviews pages require login and could not be fetched. Yelp (yelp.com/biz/alpha-mobile-detail-st-petersburg, listing shows '33 Photos' in its indexed title) blocks all fetch attempts with HTTP 403 anti-bot protection; no image or content could be retrieved. Google Images / general web search returned no usable photo URLs or descriptive alt text tied to this business's actual detailing work. No own website exists to pull photos from. Per the hard rule (fewer than 5 real curated photos = STOP and mark FAILED), the build was not started: 0 of the required minimum 5 real, work-relevant photos could be assembled. This is a photo-sourcing failure, not a rating failure (see rating section below, which did clear the minimum via an indirect, honestly-flagged figure).

owner.note: Named directly in a verbatim review found in prior research: 'Vincent from Alpha Mobile Detail came out to my house and detailed my Mustang convertible.' Confirmed as registered agent/officer on the Sunbiz LLC filing.

address_registered.note: Sunbiz-registered address (principal/mailing/registered agent address). This is a mobile detailing business (no storefront); this address is the LLC's registered address, not necessarily a public-facing shop location.

phone_verification: Consistently corroborated across multiple independent sources: general web search summaries, the (now-dead) self-servicecarwash.com aggregator listing, and Yelp listing metadata surfaced in search snippets. Used as the verified number.
phone_caution: During research, Anthropic's web-search summarization tool repeatedly and consistently surfaced a SECOND, different phone number (727) 520-2956 plus an email (Alphamobiledetail1@gmail.com) and a claimed website (www.alphamobiledetail.com), attributed to an 'Alpha mobile detail LLC' page serving Pinellas/Sarasota/Hillsborough counties. This was investigated and REJECTED: www.alphamobiledetail.com and alphamobiledetail.com both fail DNS resolution (NXDOMAIN, confirmed twice via direct getent/curl checks), so the claimed website does not exist. Since that domain is fabricated/non-existent, the associated phone and email tied to it in the same search results are treated as unverified and were NOT used anywhere in this file. This is flagged as a caution for future research on this business: the generic name 'Alpha Mobile Detail/Detailing' collides with several unrelated businesses nationally (Philadelphia PA, Concord NC, Grover Beach CA, Ocean County NJ, Pompano Beach FL, plus the two Florida look-alikes already ruled out by the user: alphamobiledetailing.ca in Canada and alphadetailingspcs.com in Jacksonville/St Augustine with phone (904) 613-8074), and AI-generated search summaries can conflate details across them.
email_note: No public email found for this exact business (2320 19th St South, St Petersburg, phone (727) 310-6361) that could be independently verified. See phone_caution above regarding a rejected candidate email. Checked: Instagram bio (page served a login-wall app shell to both WebFetch and curl, no bio text retrievable; web_profile_info API is broken per known issue), Facebook About/root (facebookexternalhit fetch only returned og:description 'Alpha mobile detail LLC. 319 likes. Mobile Detailing', no email), no Linktree found, no own website to check.
instagram_note: Confirmed as the business's real account (matches the name given). Downloaded all 11 currently public photos via scripts/ig_photos.py (Railway service, cloud path). Content is personal/lifestyle, not business portfolio content: a child on a porch, a black-and-white trumpet-player portrait, thrift-store shopping haul, a couple selfie, a phone screenshot of text messages, three people in Halloween pumpkin-head costumes, a couple dressed up for an event, a Donald Trump video thumbnail screenshot, a jar of Flintstones gummies, and a deck of Uno cards. Zero photos of vehicles, detailing work, or before/after results. This is the root cause of the build failure.
facebook_note: Confirmed authentic via direct fetch (facebookexternalhit user agent): og:title 'Alpha mobile detail LLC', og:description 'Alpha mobile detail LLC. 319 likes. Mobile Detailing'. The og:image resolves to the business's own logo graphic (blue/gray car-and-water-splash icon with 'Alpha Mobile Detail' wordmark on black background), downloaded and visually confirmed, but this is a logo, not work photography. The page's photo timeline, reviews tab and about page all render as a login-required shell (HTTP 200 but only 'Facebook'/'Error Facebook' title, no content) when fetched without an authenticated session; could not retrieve the actual photo gallery despite the Facebook page existing and being active (319 likes).
rating_source: NO verificable en vivo. La unica cifra encontrada (4.8 estrellas / 29 reseñas) proviene indirectamente de self-servicecarwash.com/detailer/alpha-mobile-detail-llc, una pagina agregadora que HOY esta caida (confirmado: sin resolucion DNS via getent hosts, y 502 Bad Gateway al intentar la conexion HTTPS por el proxy de salida; ademas Wayback Machine no tiene ningun snapshot archivado de esa URL). La cifra sigue apareciendo en resumenes de busqueda porque el motor de busqueda conserva un extracto/indice de la pagina de cuando estaba viva, no porque la pagina responda hoy. Se intentaron en vivo, en esta sesion: Yelp (bloquea el fetch directo con 403 anti-bot, tanto via WebFetch como via curl con user-agent de navegador; los resumenes de busqueda sobre Yelp solo repiten la misma cifra de self-servicecarwash sin extraer un numero propio de Yelp), Google Business/Maps (sin resultados especificos, solo paginas de ayuda genericas de Google), BBB (fetch directo de la categoria 'Auto Detailing' en Saint Petersburg, FL: el negocio NO aparece listado, sin perfil BBB), Nextdoor (sin resultados especificos para este negocio). Un dato en vivo SI se pudo confirmar de forma independiente: la propia pagina de Facebook del negocio (319 likes) aparece en un resumen de busqueda como 'Not yet rated' con 3 reviews de Facebook, una cifra genuina pero DISTINTA (y por debajo del minimo de 10) del rating de Google/agregador que se busca verificar; no se usa como el rating principal porque Facebook y Google llevan conteos de reseñas separados. Conclusion operativa: no hay forma de verificar en vivo el 4.8/29, pero es la unica cifra disponible (indirecta, de una fuente que existio y fue indexada, ahora caida) y CUMPLE el minimo (rating>=4.5, reviews>=10) si se acepta como esta. Esta decision de rating fue SUFICIENTE para continuar segun las reglas de la tarea; el build se detuvo por la razon de fotos (ver failed_reason), no por el rating.
sunbiz_status_note: Un resumen de busqueda indico que Sunbiz muestra la LLC como INACTIVE con disolucion administrativa por no presentar el reporte anual (evento fechado 09/26/2025), mientras que otra fuente (city-data.com, posiblemente con datos cacheados mas antiguos) la muestra ACTIVE. El fetch directo a Sunbiz.gov fue bloqueado (403). No se pudo confirmar el estado actual de la entidad de forma definitiva; se deja como nota informativa, no como motivo de fallo (la disolucion administrativa por reporte anual es comun y no implica necesariamente que el negocio dejo de operar).
own_site_check: Sin dominio propio confirmado. Probados sin resolucion DNS (NXDOMAIN confirmado con getent hosts + curl): alphamobiledetail.com, www.alphamobiledetail.com, alphamobiledetailstpete.com, alphamobiledetailstpetersburg.com, alphamobiledetailingfl.com. Descartados explicitamente como negocios DISTINTOS (confirmado por el usuario y corroborado en busqueda): alphamobiledetailing.ca (Alpha Mobile Detailing Services, Canada) y alphadetailingspcs.com (Alpha Mobile Detailing Specialists LLC, Jacksonville/St Augustine FL, telefono distinto (904) 613-8074, fundada 2019, veteran-owned). has_own_site: false confirmado.
services_note: No se encontro un menu de precios propio ni lista de servicios de primera mano (sin website propio, sin plataforma de reservas visible, Yelp/Facebook bloqueados para extraer el menu). Los unicos servicios verificables provienen de resumenes de busqueda reiterados (probablemente derivados de la misma pagina agregadora ahora caida): 'ceramic coating' y 'full detailing for all vehicles', mas menciones en reseñas de limpieza de interior y exterior. Insuficiente para publicar una lista de servicios con precios; de haberse construido el site, se habria usado 'Get a quote' / 'Call for pricing' sin inventar precios.
